create_benchmark_reducer_subclass: create a subclass of BenchmarkReducer implementing join_results, save_results, compute_metrics, save_metrics, and log_metrics abstract methods
run_json_df_reducer: instantiate JsonDFReducer with a benchmark name and target data path to reduce JSON result files into a pandas DataFrame
compute_metrics_mae: call compute_metrics on a JsonDFReducer to compute mean absolute error for common columns between results and target DataFrames
join_json_results: call join_results on a JsonDFReducer to concatenate multiple JSON result files from a directory into a single DataFrame
save_and_log_metrics: call save_metrics to write computed metrics to a compressed JSON file and log_metrics to send them to the configured logger
